narrative.intro: Fluor Marine Propulsion obligated $373M in federal contracts in FY2027 to date. Fiscal-year totals show Fluor Marine Propulsion obligated $3.6B in FY22, $3.5B in FY23, $3.5B in FY24, $3.6B in FY25, and $4.3B in FY26. The current-year total is partial because FY27 is fiscal year to date. Fluor Marine Propulsion’s FY27 picture reflects a pause or taper compared with prior years driven by the single award counted to date. Contractors and contracting officers watching Fluor Marine Propulsion should note the sharp year-over-year drop in obligations and the concentration of FY27 obligations into one award, as those are the defining features of the vendor’s federal activity so far this fiscal year.
